taskDescription: Match each type of human louse (left) to its characteristic habitat or infestation site (right).

cards.imageAlt: Microscopic dorsal view of Pediculus humanus capitis (head louse) with elongated body and six hair-grasping legs
cards.matchAlt: Nits cemented to hair shafts near the scalp in the occipital region, characteristic of active pediculosis capitis

cards.imageAlt: Microscopic dorsal view of Pediculus humanus corporis (body louse), slightly larger than the head louse
cards.matchAlt: Body lice and nits in the seams of clothing, the characteristic habitat of Pediculus humanus corporis

cards.imageAlt: Microscopic dorsal view of Pthirus pubis (crab louse) showing distinctive short, wide, crab-shaped body
cards.matchAlt: Crab louse firmly attached to coarse body hair, showing the characteristic broad body and powerful grasping claws of Pthirus pubis
